newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank shareholders approve Rashid deal.
newsitem.headline: Maybank shareholders approve Rashid deal.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd, said on Thursday its shareholders had approved the sale of a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik Bank to stockbrokers Rashid Hussain Bhd.

"...At the extraordinary general meeting of Malayan Banking Bhd held today... the proposed disposal of Maybank's equity stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd of 245,510 375 ordinary shares to Rashid Hussain was duly passed," the company said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Maybank is Malaysia's largest commercial bank in terms of assets.
In November Rashid Hussain finalised a deal to acquire a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik from Maybank at 8.80 ringgit per share.
Rashid also announced a number of related deals in which Kwong Yik will merge with 20 percent owned associate DCB Holdings Bhd's banking unit, DCB Bank Bhd.
